known_unused_cmap_warning: Six generic folio font ToUnicode bfrange entries have malformed odd-length non-BMP destinations. No affected source CID is used in either final document. All actual folio glyphs have valid Unicode mappings and extraction/pagination checks pass. veraPDF PDF/A-2b independently passes; semantic accessibility is not asserted.

toc_visual_review.method: Each exact converted page PNG was displayed individually with view_image and inspected for indentation, wrapping, right-column alignment, margins, continuation headings, and folios.

limitations: The unused generic folio ToUnicode ranges are malformed; no affected source CID is used, so current content and folios extract correctly.
No semantic-tagging or PDF/UA conformance claim.
Technical PDF/A-2b validation does not itself assert institutional format acceptance.

Main-builder execution identities are supplied by the authoring agent and independently bound to retained exact source snapshots; the earlier main build manifests did not themselves log execution-time builder SHA.
